entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Me ɖu ɖase, O Mawuyen, be ye ɖówun né má jesiye eye né má sumɔye. Le gayame a, me yán wunsenmaɖoyen ku wunsenɖoɖoo ayayen kú ɖɔkuo. Mawu ɖokpo me gba lei tóvo neo, kpeɖeamewuntitɔ le Xaxame, Ame ke su eɖokoi jí a.
